House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". An original short tale in the manner of a Norwegian folk tale (not a retelling of any published tale). The riddle's answer is "regn" (rain).

sentences.text: Det var en gang ei jente som het Ingrid. Hun bodde i en liten by i fjellet.
sentences.english: Once upon a time there was a girl called Ingrid. She lived in a small town in the mountains.

sentences.text: En dag skulle Ingrid gå til markedet. Hun skulle selge brød.
sentences.english: One day Ingrid was going to the market. She was going to sell bread.

sentences.text: Veien gikk til ei bro. Under brua bodde et troll.
sentences.english: The road went to a bridge. Under the bridge lived a troll.

sentences.text: Trollet var stort og mørkt. Folk var redd.
sentences.english: The troll was big and dark. People were afraid.

sentences.text: Ingrid var også redd, men hun gikk.
sentences.english: Ingrid was also afraid, but she walked on.

sentences.text: Da hun kom til brua, sa trollet: «Stopp! Du må svare på en gåte!»
sentences.english: When she came to the bridge, the troll said: "Stop! You must answer a riddle!"

sentences.text: Ingrid stoppet. Hun var redd, men hun var klok.
sentences.english: Ingrid stopped. She was afraid, but she was clever.

sentences.text: Jeg er vått. Jeg kommer når det er mørkt og kaldt. Folk i Bergen har meg ofte. Hva er jeg?
sentences.english: I am wet. I come when it is dark and cold. People in Bergen often have me. What am I?
sentences.speaker: troll

sentences.text: Ingrid tenkte lenge. Hun tenkte på byen, på været og på paraplyen sin.
sentences.english: Ingrid thought for a long time. She thought of the town, of the weather and of her umbrella.

sentences.text: Jeg vet det! Du er regn!
sentences.english: I know! You are rain!
sentences.speaker: ingrid

sentences.text: Trollet ble glad. Ingen hadde svart på gåten før.
sentences.english: The troll became glad. Nobody had answered the riddle before.

sentences.text: Du er klok, Ingrid! Du kan gå her hver dag.
sentences.english: You are clever, Ingrid! You can walk here every day.
sentences.speaker: troll

sentences.text: Ingrid solgte brødet på markedet. Hun sa til alle at trollet var snill.
sentences.english: Ingrid sold the bread at the market. She told everyone that the troll was kind.

sentences.text: Folk ville ikke tro det. Men neste dag gikk de på veien, og han sa bare: «God dag!»
sentences.english: People did not want to believe it. But the next day they walked on the road, and he only said: "Hello!"

sentences.text: Nå er folk ikke redd mer. De tar brød til ham, og han sier gåter.
sentences.english: Now people are no longer afraid. They bring bread to him, and he tells riddles.

sentences.text: Ingrid er ikke redd. Hun er klok, og hun er glad i ham.
sentences.english: Ingrid is not afraid. She is clever, and she is fond of him.

sentences.text: Hver lørdag går hun til markedet, og hver lørdag sier han: «God dag, Ingrid!»
sentences.english: Every Saturday she goes to the market, and every Saturday he says: "Hello, Ingrid!"

sentences.text: Hun selger brød, og hun er glad. Hun har en venn under brua.
sentences.english: She sells bread, and she is happy. She has a friend under the bridge.

sentences.text: Om våren og sommeren er det lyst. Om høsten er det mørkt.
sentences.english: In spring and summer it is light. In autumn it is dark.

sentences.text: I Norge har Sam bodd lenge. Han vil bo her lenger. Han har bestemt seg for ikke å reise hjem.
sentences.english: Sam has lived in Norway for a long time. He wants to live here longer. He has decided not to travel home.

sentences.text: Toget fra stasjonen gikk langt, gjennom fjellet. Utsikten var bra. Sam skal komme tilbake.
sentences.english: The train from the station went far, through the mountain. The view was good. Sam will come back.

sentences.text: Første fredagskveld i Norge satt Sam i sofaen, og de spilte ved peisen.
sentences.english: The first Friday evening in Norway Sam sat on the sofa, and they played by the fireplace.

sentences.text: De bygger skolen, og den åpner snart. Nyheten er bra. Sam vil gå dit, for der er det plass.
sentences.english: They are building the school, and it opens soon. The news is good. Sam wants to go there, because there is room there.
